source_title: Pew Religious Restrictions Around the World
direct_observation: government restrictions and social hostilities are measured separately; restrictions rose in most regions while sub-Saharan Africa declined
evidence_status: high for bounded global pattern; country index is not individual outcome evidence
next_test: link one country pattern to named group practice, safety and remedy

direct_observation: 25 countries had very high government restrictions in 2023; social hostility includes harassment, mob violence and militant activity
evidence_status: high for mechanism classification; attribution and lived exposure remain open
next_test: compare government restriction and private-hostility pathways in one place

direct_observation: USCIRF recommends CPC/SWL designations while warning that non-coverage does not prove absence of violations
evidence_status: high for policy and threshold boundary; recommendation is not remedy evidence
next_test: track designation, policy response, incident change and named community outcome

source_title: UN Special Rapporteur report on people on the move
direct_observation: freedom of religion or belief for people on the move is affected by transit, documentation, registration, detention and asylum conditions
evidence_status: medium-to-high for mobility mechanism; person-level protection and safety remain open
next_test: follow named mobile person/community through status, practice and protection encounters

source_title: UN freedom of religion or belief mandate
direct_observation: right includes having, not having, adopting or changing belief and manifesting it alone or in community, publicly or privately
evidence_status: high for normative scope; implementation and contestability remain open
next_test: test whether law and services protect minority, non-belief and changing-belief cases

direct_observation: reports combine discriminatory law, non-recognition, violence, surveillance and restrictions on texts or ceremonies
evidence_status: medium for case leads; selection, attribution, prevalence and remedy require verification
next_test: build named incident ledger with response, safety, recurrence and community voice
